in_sanskrit.name: Sahrukh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Friend, Companion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sahrukh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Someone who is a friend, a companion, and someone who is dear to your heart. It can also mean someone who is a source of happiness and joy.

in_tamil.name: Sahrukh
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Friend, Companion
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sahrukh ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Someone who is a friend, a companion, and someone who is dear to your heart. It can also mean someone who is a source of happiness and joy.

in_telugu.name: Sahrukh
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sahrukh ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Someone who is a friend, a companion, and someone who is dear to your heart. It can also mean someone who is a source of happiness and joy.

in_marathi.name: Sahrukh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahrukh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Someone who is a friend, a companion, and someone who is dear to your heart. It can also mean someone who is a source of happiness and joy.

in_bengali.name: Sahrukh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Friend, Companion
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sahrukh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Someone who is a friend, a companion, and someone who is dear to your heart. It can also mean someone who is a source of happiness and joy.
